chunks: If they call you a liar, so have other messengers been denied before you. But all things will be brought back to God.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about prophets being called liars by their people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a source of comfort (takhaffuf) for the Prophet (SAWW) and the faithful, linking his experience to the collective narrative of the Prophets (Ahl al-Bayt's lineage of truth). It emphasizes that rejection is an inherent test of prophethood, with the ultimate authority (Hakimiyyah) resting solely with Allah, who will adjudicate between the truth and the deniers on the Day of Judgment.
